## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Use a Conventional Commit title.

## Related issue

Use `Closes #number` only when this change fully resolves that issue; otherwise use `Refs #number`.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results. Explain any check that could not run.

## Compatibility

Describe public API, draft schema, LaTeX, or MSRV changes and migration steps, if applicable.

- [ ] Documentation and changelog reflect the user-visible changes.
- [ ] No private development material or AI instruction files are included.
